description: This file defines the SugarFieldAddress class, which extends SugarFieldBase and handles the display and editing of address fields within the SuiteCRM platform. It includes methods for rendering the address details and edit views, supporting template overrides via configuration.

classes.name: SugarFieldAddress
classes.description: A class responsible for rendering address fields in both detail and edit views within SuiteCRM, with support for template overrides.

methods.name: getDetailViewSmarty
methods.description: Renders the address field for the detail view, using either a custom Smarty template or the default template, with error handling for missing 'key' display parameter.

methods.name: getEditViewSmarty
methods.description: Renders the address field for the edit view, supporting template overrides and error handling for missing 'key'.
